approvalBoundary.acceptedScope: the Program Kit host-tooling extension architecture and work units bounded by the exact design and plan
doesNotAuthorize: consumer-domain identity, authorization, role, grant, policy, principal, environment, deployment, release, or workspace semantics
comprehensive Docker Compose modeling or a Program Kit container orchestrator
automatic Aspire, container, Dev Container, Keycloak, Azure, deployment, or infrastructure execution
production Keycloak provisioning, backup, migration, or administration
a custom general-purpose OpenAPI client generator
opaque-token introspection, dynamic client registration, provider discovery, or automatic issuer selection
device authorization, CIBA, FAPI, DPoP, implicit flow, resource-owner-password flow, or generic JavaScript generation
automatic real-provider login, credential capture, bypass of MFA, passkeys, consent, conditional access, CAPTCHA, or another provider-controlled human interaction
application or consumer-domain observability meaning, a business-event or security-audit ledger, compliance evidence, telemetry backend, collector, dashboard, alert, retention, or incident policy
automatic telemetry emission from Program Kit generation, validation, design, or development-session tools
a base semantic dependency on Serilog, NLog, Application Insights, Seq, Grafana, Prometheus, or another vendor product

a universal interpolated secret string, centralized Program Kit secret provider, store or broker, live-configuration control plane, or generic remote configuration-editing endpoint
coercion of every protected capability into IConfiguration, disclosure of classified secret locators, or silent merging of generated bases and human/provider-owned overlays
a universal guarantee of atomic, zero-downtime, rollback-capable, cross-process, or last-known-good secret rotation
credentials, network discovery, cloud mutation, deployment, publication, or release activity
a material deviation from the reviewed design or plan

validation.focusedArchitectureTests: passed: the exact 1.3.0 host-tooling architecture JSON passed JsonSchemaWorkbenchValidator against the composite Program Kit schema set and ArchitectureDesignValidator through a temporary review-only test harness; the harness was removed after execution
validation.fullSuiteFinding: The clean Orbyss.ProgramKit.UnitTests assembly passed 293 of 293 tests after the temporary exact-design harness was removed. A prior bounded full-solution run exceeded 120 seconds and a no-restore attempt stopped at existing PKCS174 raw-reference import validation; no gate was weakened, and broader solution closure remains implementation evidence.
validation.reviewBinding: all artifact digests and the plan-to-design digest binding were recomputed from repository bytes
validation.commandLineFinding: The current validate command requires a top-level $schema selector while architecture-design.schema.json forbids that undeclared property. Validation therefore used the same direct Workbench schema validator and semantic validator exercised by repository conformance tests; PKHT-W010 must close the CLI/schema-selection inconsistency rather than weakening the schema.

provenance.details: Version 1.3.0 adds the explicitly aligned reusable design-time configuration compiler for Program Kit-owned and external-owner-supplied typed definitions, typed secret-reference/resolver/result/lifecycle/change-signal/consumer-reaction contracts, rotation compatibility validation, strict generated-base/overlay/provider ownership, and runtime generator isolation. It introduces no centralized secret provider or store, universal secret string, live-configuration control plane, external configuration semantic ownership, or universal rotation guarantee. The exact local and external source set is enumerated in design-intent.md, canonical architecture-design.json, and architecture-design.md. No runtime implementation, external execution, secret resolution, credential handling, or approval record was created.

supersedes.reason: The human extended the still-unapproved review set with a reusable deterministic configuration compiler, typed secret-resolution and rotation contracts, explicit consumer-reaction compatibility, and strict design-time/runtime and generated/human/provider ownership boundaries.
